about.title: Built for mutual aid
about.body: Communalists is a free platform where neighbors organize. Start an <org>organization</org> for your <mutualAid>mutual aid</mutualAid> group, <toolLibrary>tool library</toolLibrary> or community club, find groups near you, and run them with tools made for how mutual aid actually works.
about.languages: Available in English, Español, Tiếng Việt and 中文.

organizations.title: Organizations

import.title: Import organizations
import.intro: Add many unclaimed organizations at once from a CSV. Review each one as its page will look, fix or remove rows, then add the ready ones.
import.existingHint: Download every organization already on Communalists, including unlisted, unclaimed and deleted ones, so research can skip them. The file has details of unlisted organizations, so keep it private. Each download is recorded in the super user log.
import.fileHint: Nothing is added until you review the rows and confirm. Required columns: name, focusAreas, placeId, reach and languages. Up to 200 rows. The prepare-organizations-csv skill describes every column.

import.confirmBody: Each one gets a public page labeled Unclaimed and shows up in Find right away. Rows that need attention ({skipped}) are left out and stay here to fix. To take one down later, delete it from its page.
import.allRemoved: Every row is removed. Use Undo to bring one back.
import.leftToReview: Rows that weren't added are still below. Fix them and add again, or download them.

problems.invalid: This isn't a value this column accepts.

fixes.required: Fill it in, or remove the row if the research couldn't find it.
fixes.tooLong: Shorten it. Names allow 80 characters, descriptions 2,000 and street addresses 200.
fixes.handleTooShort: Use a longer handle, like the name with hyphens.
fixes.handleTooLong: Shorten it to 30 characters, for example by dropping words like "of the".
fixes.handleFormat: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, like south-bay-mutual-aid.
fixes.handleReserved: Pick another, for example by adding the city.
fixes.handleTaken: If it's the same group, remove this row. If not, edit the handle, for example by adding the city.
fixes.focusAreasRequired: Use 1 to 3 of: general, food, housing, transportation, technology, health, childcare, education, clothing, hygiene, lending, disasterRelief, legal, labor, arts, hobbies, faith, animals, environment, other. Or edit the row to pick them from a list.
fixes.focusAreasTooMany: Keep the 3 that matter most to someone looking for help.
fixes.placeRequired: Edit the row and choose the city from the list, or remove the row.
fixes.placeNotFound: Edit the row and choose the city from the list.
fixes.placeMismatch: Edit the row and choose the right city from the list.
fixes.radiusRequired: Edit the row and choose a radius, or set its reach to national or international.
fixes.languagesRequired: Use codes like en, es, vi, zh, tl or ko. Or edit the row to pick them from a list.
fixes.invalidUrl: Use the organization's own site, like example.org, or leave it blank.
fixes.invalidEmail: Use the organization's public address, or leave it blank.
fixes.invalidPhone: Include the area code, like (415) 555-0123, or leave it blank.
fixes.invalidYear: Leave it blank if no source gives the year.
fixes.socialInvalid: Use just the username, like sbma, not a link or a display name.
fixes.socialMismatch: Use just the username, like sbma.
fixes.socialPlatform: Use instagram, facebook, facebookGroup, x, bluesky, tiktok, youtube, telegram. Put other platforms in the notes.
fixes.duplicateInFile: If they're the same group, remove one. If not, edit one so their names and handles differ.
fixes.sameName: Open the existing page. If it's the same group, remove this row. If it's a different group, edit the name so people can tell them apart, for example by adding the city.
fixes.sameWebsite: Open the existing page. If it's the same group, remove this row.
fixes.invalid: Edit the row to choose a value from the list.

addErrors.notAllowed: Only super users can do this.

upload.title: Upload a definition
upload.intro: Replace one word’s text, in every language, with the text in a file. You’ll see every change before anything is saved. Related words stay as they are.
upload.formatOneRow: A CSV with one word: the same columns as the import (slug, then en_word, en_definition and en_details, and the same for es, vi and zh), and one row.
upload.formatSlug: slug must be a word already in the dictionary. To add a new word, import it instead.
upload.formatRelated: A related column is ignored. Change related words in the edit form.

status.ready: {file}: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} to {word}.
status.unchanged: {file} matches {word} as it is now. There’s nothing to change.
status.notFound: No word has the address {slug}. To add it, import the file instead.
status.problems: {file}: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} to fix before it can be used.

upload.relatedIgnored: The file lists related words. They’re ignored: the word keeps the related words it has.
upload.ignored: These columns aren’t used and were left out: {columns}
upload.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# field changes} other {# fields change}} right away, on the word’s page and wherever it’s marked. There’s no undo, but you can edit the word afterward.

fileProblems.missingColumns: The file is missing these columns: {columns}. Use the import’s template.
fileProblems.notOneRow: The file must have exactly one word: a header and one row. To add many words, import them instead.
fileProblems.tooBig: The file is too big. Keep it under 500 KB.
fileProblems.notAllowed: Only super users can do this.
fileProblems.otherWord: This file is for {fileSlug}, not {slug}. Upload it on that word’s edit page, or on Upload a definition.

saveErrors.changed: The word changed after you checked the file, so nothing was saved. Check the file again to see the latest.
saveErrors.notAllowed: Only super users can do this.

replace.title: Replace from a file
replace.intro: Upload a one-word CSV for {word} to replace its text in every language. You’ll see every change before anything is saved. Related words stay as they are, and anything you’ve typed in the form below and not saved is lost.

remove.title: Remove this word
remove.intro: Takes {word} out of the dictionary for good.
remove.confirmBody: Its page stops working, and it’s taken off other words’ related words. Where our pages mark it, it shows as plain text. There’s no undo, but the super user log keeps a copy of its text.

errors.notFound: That word is already gone. Go back to the dictionary to see the latest.
errors.notAllowed: Only super users can do this.
